summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Pony AI Inc., a Cayman Islands-incorporated company with weighted voting rights, announcing a routine board meeting scheduled for August 18, 2026. The meeting agenda includes the consideration and approval of the group's unaudited financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, and their publication. An earnings conference call for management is also planned. The filing contains no terms related to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a standard periodic report of financial results, not a special situation event.
